messages:
Maria: Heads-up — BrioHealth (enterprise demo in 2h) reporting 429s from EU dedicated pool, long queue times. Can we get a temporary capacity bump or routing? :grimacing:
Raj: They're with CTO onsite. Requesting soft-cap override for 6h. Can route to us-east if latency <250ms.
Henry: Checking cluster: eu-west-1-gpu-pool queue depth spiked, 95th token latency 3x. Admission control throttling new sessions. Current limits: max_concurrent_sessions=120, max_queue=500.
Maria: Client error snippet:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-reason: pool-saturated
x-queue-pos: 321
```
QuotaBot: [automated] Quota enforcement triggered: eu-west-1 reserved pool at 100% soft quota. Overrides need infra lead + finance approval.
Ops: We can evict best-effort batch jobs and bump concurrency by 20% but costs will rise. ETA ~10m to reconfigure.
Linda: BrioHealth prefers no region hop. If latency degrades they may cancel demo.
Henry: Options:
- A) Temp soft-cap +30% on eu-west (fast, costs more, needs override)
- B) Route ~20% of new sessions to us-east-1 (warm-up ~8m, slightly worse p99)
Which to proceed? @Raj @Ops
Raj: Approve Option A. Sales will cover demo support surcharge. I'll get finance sign-off.
Maria: +1 — include automated rollback at t+6h.
Henry: Running dry-run:
```
infractl pools update eu-west-1-gpu-pool --concurrency=144 --temp-override=6h
```
Ops: Also toggling eviction of preemptible workloads.
QuotaBot: [automated] Override request logged: req-7721, awaiting infra lead action.
Henry: Override applied. Queue depth falling, token latency improving. Monitoring 30m.
Raj: Sent signed demo support note to finance. Notified customer. :thumbsup:
Maria: Customer confirmed demo proceeding. Will reopen if issues.
Ops: Postmortem items: playbook for demo-day surge, add auto-failover when pool saturation >90%.
Henry: Opening follow-up ticket for capacity planning sync.
Maria: Closing loop — will reopen if anything else crops up. :lock:
